nom: AXIS-Y Dark Spot Correcting Glow Serum

avis.titre: Good on skin not good on smell.
avis.texte: I have been using this product for approximately one week. I find it pleasant and it feels good on my skin. I have not observed any changes yet, but I intend to continue using it. The scent is not particularly appealing; it almost has a smell reminiscent of bacon. If it weren't for this unusual odor, I would have given it a four-star rating.

avis.titre: Vitamin C from Korean brandVitamin C from Korean brand
avis.texte: I do like Korean beauty products and Rovectin Dark Spot Serum is meant to brighten skin, get rid of dark spots, help skin glow, and moisturize. It has vitamin c from tree water and 9 types of vitamin complex, as well as niacinamide, ethyl ascorbyl water, and arbutin. It is scent free and goes on smoothly and absorbs quickly. I don't have any dark spots or sensitive skin, but it worked well into my usual skincare regimen. My skin felt moisturized - I'm not sure about how much glow or brightening effects it had on me - but it worked fine. I do think the price per the 1.35 fl oz is a little bit more than what I'm used to paying for in Asian skincare. Otherwise no complaints!
I am almost done with the serum but haven't noticed a major difference. Maybe I need to keep trying this for longer but it has been 6 weeks and no improvement.

avis.titre: Moisturizing—but gave me little zitsMoisturizing—but gave me little zits
avis.texte: It has taken me a few weeks on and off to try this I think the longest I went to using it was four or five consecutive nights because after 3 to 4 nights of using it consecutively I’d get a small zit or two though I feel like other than than, my skin feels fine. I like that dries down in a minute or so and it’s not sticky when it gets absorbed in the skin. It is fragrance free and my skin feels moisturized and hydrated after putting it on, but I do add moisturizer on top of it after it gets absorbed. Unfortunately, I couldn’t effectively say that it helped with my dark spots mainly because I didn’t use it as consistently and long enough to test that claim.

avis.titre: this whole line from Rovectin is top-notch; recommended even for sensitive skin
avis.texte: Rovectin is well-known for their OG line which is made to help repair damaged, dry, and struggling skin. It's a MAGICAL line for people with sensitive skin, eczema, and other issues, and I love all the products in it for repairing my moisture barrier. Since those were their flagship products, they mostly tweaked those and didn't really focus on new product lines until recently -- this one and the Cica blemish line. I have the majority of the products from this line and I absolutely love all of them even for my super sensitive skin. They all work with my skin without triggering my eczema or rosacea and zero irritation, and I find they work best used in combination consistently over time to get the best possible results. I layer the serum and the cream daily and really love the combination; the cream feels more like a barrier cream than a brightening one and it's super comfortable on the skin. I've also tried the hydrogel masks which are a more intensive treatment and those are also really good. The serum has a ton of brightening ingredients and reminds me somewhat of the M&M Blackberry one but with a slightly thicker, more gel like texture. My skin actual prefers this one to the M&M; it absorbs faster and is less sticky even though it has an aloe-like consistency. It doesn't pill under my moisturizer and sunscreen, and I like the natural herbal smell from the ingredients (no added fragrance). The formula is hydrating and even moisturizing, especially when used in combination w

Same opinion with other reviews: very hydrating. Slight herbal scent, acceptable. I find my skin glow better after using- the way it glows is something that only myself will notice, not my husband of course.
This is a great product Nice and light and feels nice in the skin
